title: General extraction of alkaloids in acidic medium
author: Rômulo Pereira de Jesus

steps.title: Weigh plant material
steps.instruction: Place approximately 1 g of dry, powdered plant material into a 50 mL glass Falcon tube.

steps.title: Add acidic solution
steps.instruction: Add 20 mL of 1 M HCl solution to the tube and vortex for 10 seconds.

steps.title: First sonication
steps.instruction: Place the tube in an ultrasonic bath set to 60 °C and sonicate for 480 seconds (8 minutes).

steps.title: Add ethyl acetate
steps.instruction: Add 20 mL of ethyl acetate, then vortex the mixture for 10 seconds.

steps.title: Alkalinize and second sonication
steps.instruction: Add 1 M NH₄OH dropwise until the pH reaches ~10 (verify with pH strip); then sonicate again at 60 °C for 480 seconds.

steps.title: Vortex and centrifuge
steps.instruction: Vortex the tube for 3 seconds, then centrifuge at 4500 rpm for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Collect upper organic layer
steps.instruction: Using an automatic pipette, carefully transfer the upper ethyl acetate layer (containing the alkaloids) to a clean glass Falcon tube.

steps.title: Evaporate ethyl acetate
steps.instruction: Evaporate the transferred ethyl acetate to dryness using a rotary evaporator (SpeedVac) to obtain the alkaloids in pure form.

steps.title: Qualitative detection with Dragendorff
steps.instruction: Perform Dragendorff test on the extracted alkaloids.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 0.3–0.5 mL of the alkaloid residue into a test tube.
Add 0.3–0.5 mL of Dragendorff reagent and gently mix.
Observe formation of orange‑red precipitate; presence indicates alkaloids.
If needed, gently heat the mixture in a water bath to enhance the reaction (optional).
